Author: Kyuuso
Name: Eureka Suite
Punchline: All-in-one Eureka suite: aggro radars, live tracker sync, bunny helpers and Logos & Loot errands.
Description: All-in-one quality-of-life suite for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Features lethal aggro radar visualizers (sleeping dragon sound aggro, low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, vision cones, combat cast alerts), real-time ffxiv-eureka.com Phoenix WebSocket tracker synchronization, bunny FATE timer and coffer markers, and Logos & Loot errands. Bunny FATE automation is unlocked by a privately granted access package.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Bozja Suite
Punchline: Save the Queen field operations helper: critical engagement tracker, fragment planner with market prices.
Description: Early beta. Quality-of-life suite for the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor. Tracks critical engagements and skirmishes with enlistment alerts, shows your Resistance rank and mettle, lists the forgotten fragments you carry and plans which fragments to farm or buy for the Lost Action you want, with Universalis prices. Field automation (skirmishes, critical engagements, Castrum Lacus Litore and the Dalriada through BossMod Reborn and Rotation Solver) is unlocked by a privately granted access package.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Zodiac Helper
Punchline: Companion for ZodiacBuddy Reborn: automates the Novus, Nexus, Zodiac and Zeta steps of the ARR relics.
Description: Early beta. Helper for the ARR Zodiac relic line that works next to ZodiacBuddy Reborn. Infuses the materia you hold into your Sphere Scrolls, hands your relics to Jalzahn for each upgrade, and farms Light and Mahatmas through AutoDuty, with Remon attaching the next Mahatma. Optional: AutoDuty for the farms, vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs, Lifestream for inn rooms.
TestingChangelog:
0.8.22, changes since 0.8.0:
- Report a problem now opens our Discord instead of a GitHub issue. Send the .log file to Kyuuso by DM or post it in the plugin's thread in #plugins. The text you typed is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with the file.
- Capture leves keep your armour on at first. Each target that dies before the /soothe takes one more piece off for that job and level, body and legs first, and the count is saved. A level 100 character may lose a few targets the first time while it learns.
- Free Trial accounts skip every market board purchase and the main tab says so, since the game does not let them use the market board.
- Capture leves no longer switch to normal combat after riding to the next target. Before, the AI came back on and attacked a winter nix that was already pacified.
- Capture leves start the auto-attack with the hotbar's Auto-attack command. The old call got "Cannot execute at this time." with the weak weapon on, so the targets were never hit.
- Capture leves send the chocobo away and turn off the BossMod AI, its preset and Rotation Solver, even when you had them on. Only the auto-attack hits the targets, so a skill or the chocobo no longer kills one before the /soothe.
- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.
Still to test before 1.0: party sharing between two clients, and a second relic on the same character.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Anima Helper
Punchline: Heavensward Anima relic: buys, farms and turns in for you.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Anima (Heavensward) weapons through their stages: accepts the stage quests, buys the Poetics items (farming Poetics with AutoDuty when short), runs the step duties through AutoDuty and turns the quests in. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs.
TestingChangelog: 0.5.13: Report a problem now opens our Discord instead of a GitHub issue. Send the .log file to Kyuuso by DM or post it in the plugin's thread in #plugins. The text you typed is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with the file.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Manderville Helper
Punchline: Endwalker Manderville relic: farms Poetics, buys the upgrade items and turns in for you.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Manderville (Endwalker) weapons up to the stage you pick: farms Poetics with AutoDuty, buys the 3 upgrade items of each stage from Jubrunnah, and accepts and turns in the stage quest at the House Manderville Artisan, job after job. Needs AutoDuty for the farm and vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Phantom Helper
Punchline: Dawntrail Phantom relic: arcanite, exchanges, Trust farms and the Occult Crescent events you still need.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Phantom weapons (Dawntrail) through their stages: buys arcanite and the one-time quest items, farms the uncapped tomestone and the Final Phantasm dungeons with Trust through AutoDuty, trades weapons at Dodokkuli, and lists the Occult Crescent FATEs and critical encounters that drop the demiatma, dispellers and crystal paste you still need. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking.
